Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

An additional reinforcement of the Agents of Atlas team will take place!

 

Through this additional patch, Captain America (Sharon Rogers), 
Luna Snow, Crescent, and White Fox will be even stronger.

 

Check out the new looks of these heroes with their new Uniforms and Tier-3 advancement
by downloading the 9/22 patch data.
 

■ 9/22 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 9/23 (Thu) 4:00 (UTC+0), 9/22 (Wed) 21:00 (PDT)
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch. 
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.
 

[9/23 (Thu) 02:47 (UTC+0) / 9/22 (Wed) 19:47 (PDT) Added]

 

The patch has been completed as of 9/23 (Thu) 02:47 (UTC+0), 9/22 (Wed) 19:47 (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

 

 

▣ 3 New Uniforms

 

New armor for the Agents of Atlas heroes are now ready as they prepare for space exploration.
Check out the abilities of Captain America (Sharon Rogers), 
Luna Snow, and Crescent <Light Sirius Armor> Uniforms.

* The new uniforms can be purchased after the 8/17 patch data is applied
   and all Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off.
* The 3 new Uniforms can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* Skills are based on the maximum stats.
 

 

 

 

▣  White Fox Tier-3 & Ultimate Skill

 

One of the main supporting heroes White Fox, can now be advanced to Tier-3.
Her upgraded abilities would be a great help in battles for allies and herself as well!
 

 

 

▣ Other Information

 

1.  The hit count of Crescent’s Tier-3 Ultimate Skill Moonlight Shockwave has increased.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of some stats of the 4th character gear not being applied to the growth score has been fixed.
2. The issue of the Instinct stat that increases through hero growth not being applied properly in specific ranges has been fixed.

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held for the Agents of Atlas heroes.

 

Thank you.
